newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares close up on Wall St gains.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares close up on Wall St gains.

text.p: Brazilian stocks ended higher in thin trade, boosted by a rising Dow Jones, despite early declines in Cemig state power firm and other leading shares, brokers said.
"Volume was weak but prices rose because New York is up," a dealer said.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 49 most-traded shares rose 0.65 percent to close at 69,577 points on slow turnover of 231 million reais ($222.3 million).
